method: L2 logistic regression (C=1) on standardized single features, per fold; Holm-Bonferroni over 79 features within each of 10 eval folds of UNIVARIATE_OOF.csv
detail: Individual univariate significance is not asserted at the 10-fold Holm level: no p_holm < 0.05 was found (min 0.1741). Resolution is limited by the 200-permutation cap; the audit therefore refrains from claiming any single feature strong signal and does not rely on univariate significance for promotion.
